analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 53.1 to 60.5, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -0.7070 to 3.2982, strengthening the uptrend. A Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low ($715.08) higher than the 20-day low ($700.00). Current price $737.05 is near the swing resistance of $737.62, but with sustained upward momentum, it's a buy entry opportunity.
